_what_this_file_is: The trained MUAC regression that turns the scale-invariant image features
into centimetres. Fitted in Python (tools/export_calibration.py) on the
SAME segmenter and frame count the app runs -- MediaPipe's on-device selfie
segmenter, single frontal frame -- not the desktop yolo11x-seg pipeline.
The app applies: muac_cm = intercept + sum(coef_i * (x_i - mean_i) / scale_i),
matching sklearn's SimpleImputer(median) -> StandardScaler -> RidgeCV chain.
_validated_accuracy: 20-seed paired cross-validation on this exact config (weight-anchored
inputs, mp-selfie segmenter, single frame): MUAC MAE 1.0865 cm.
comparison against the desktop segmenter and the old height-based config
A fresh 80/20 held-out check at export time (not the shipped fit): 1.0757 cm on n=367, single-split noise expected.
_not_yet_done: This file is a research artifact, produced outside android/ on purpose:
copying it into android/app/src/main/assets/, updating ChildDetails.kt to
make height optional and require weight, and updating Analyzer.kt's
buildFeatures() to match are separate, not-yet-done app changes.
